profile.headline: Software Engineer at Design Interactive, Inc.
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the Computer Software industry. Strong engineering professional skilled in full stack Web application development. mobile application development using ionic, desktop applications using Electron. versatile in various frameworks and programming languages.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description: Full stack web application developer. Team leader, mentor, teacher. Perform analysis, programming, testing, debugging, and modifications of computer programs and hardware devices for complex software products. Technology used: AngulaJS, AngulaCLI, Angular V2 and up, NodeJS, typescript, MYSQL, Postgress, MongoDB, Spring framework, docker, aws, Azure, continuous integration,  Mobile web development using ionic, desktop applications using Electron

positions.title: Software Engineer Technical Lead
positions.description: Led developer/ tech lead system design and architect, full stack web application development, Managing, mentoring and teaching team members. using Frameworks Angular, NodeJS, React, Blazor, and languages include Java, C#, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, SASS, SQL, Postgres. deplying systems using Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure, Digital Ocean. Working with AI integrations and role play AI work flows. Collaborate with Stakeholders and project managers to deliver end users wnat's & needs.
